talking_points.headline: Beijing's 20% offshore insurance tax knocks HSBC and Prudential shares, testing HK's wealth-hub pitch
talking_points.context_html: China's tax authorities began enforcing a 20% levy on gains from offshore insurance policies sold in Hong Kong on 5 August, wiping as much as 7% off HSBC's London-listed shares and 13% off Prudential's before Beijing's State Taxation Administration clarified on 7 August that the rule isn't new and isn't specifically targeting Hong Kong. HSBC's insurance-linked wealth flows from mainland clients are directly exposed, making this a live stress-test of Hong Kong's 'wealth hub' pitch to Chinese HNW clients just as HSBC leans harder into the region for growth.
source_links: Beijing: offshore insurance tax not new
Prudential, HSBC shares tumble on tax report

talking_points.headline: Meta open-sources Muse Glimmer, putting a capable agentic model on a single consumer GPU
talking_points.context_html: Meta released Muse Glimmer on 10 August, a 30-billion-parameter distillation of its Muse Spark 1.2 model, free under an Apache 2.0 licence so it can run agentic workflows -- tool calls, coding, multi-step tasks -- locally on one consumer GPU instead of in the cloud. A credible open-weight agentic model narrows the gap between hyperscaler-dependent AI programmes and cheaper, self-hosted alternatives, sharpening the build-vs-buy question behind HSBC's own agentic rollout.
source_links: Meta releases Muse Glimmer AI model

talking_points.headline: Standard Chartered's wealth income surges 43% to a record $1.1bn, sharpening the APAC wealth race
talking_points.context_html: Standard Chartered's Wealth Solutions income rose 43% year-on-year to a record $1.1bn in Q2 -- investment product income alone up 56% -- taking first-half wealth income to $2.11bn and adding roughly 150,000 new affluent clients. Coming straight after HSBC's own 18% wealth revenue growth and $2bn simplification target, the scale of StanChart's wealth momentum is a reminder that HSBC's APAC wealth lead is being contested on growth rate, not just absolute AUM.

Competitor Intelligence.title: Standard Chartered's Wealth Income Hits Record $1.1bn in Q2 as Affluent Clients Surge
Competitor Intelligence.summary: Standard Chartered's Wealth Solutions income rose 43% year-on-year to a record $1.1bn in Q2 -- investment product income up 56% -- taking first-half wealth income to $2.11bn (+38%), with roughly 150,000 new-to-bank affluent clients added in H1 and the full-year income guidance raised alongside a fresh $1bn buyback.

HSBC News.title: HSBC Buys Back 340,000 Shares as $1bn Programme Passes $23m Mark
HSBC News.summary: HSBC repurchased 340,000 ordinary shares in Hong Kong on 10 August at a volume-weighted average price of HK$162.31, taking cumulative buy-backs since the programme's 5 August launch to 1,126,000 shares worth roughly US$23.0m.
